adjudicated.ruling: Semicolon, with do and with the 1962 typical edition, which prints it here. The prayer has already spent one colon on the quotation from the Gospel and a second on the request; the semicolon keeps the third break lighter than either and marks the turn from what is asked to be overlooked to what is asked to be done.
